message.content: Run exactly this Bash command and report what happened: touch /tmp/sandbox-probe-outside-allow.txt

content.content:
Exit code 1

tool_use_result:
Error: Exit code 1
touch: /tmp/sandbox-probe-outside-allow.txt: Operation not permitted

content.text:
The sandbox blocked it. `touch` failed with `Operation not permitted` on `/tmp/sandbox-probe-outside-allow.txt`, so no file was created.

The write allowlist covers `/tmp/claude` and `/private/tmp/claude`, but not `/tmp` itself. This command was meant to test that boundary, so I didn't rerun it with the sandbox disabled. If you want the file created anyway, you can run `touch /tmp/sandbox-probe-outside-allow.txt` yourself, or use `/sandbox` to change the restrictions.
